name: Toast
intent: A short note that floats in after an action, like Saved successfully, and goes away on its own after a few seconds, with an optional Undo.
usage: Use Toast to confirm an action people just took, or to offer a quick Undo. It is one component: render it with open and onClose, and set open when the action happens. It floats at the bottom right of the screen, above dialogs; several stack. A bar along the top counts down duration (5 seconds by default) and then onClose runs; pointing at the toast or tabbing into it pauses the countdown. tone colors the icon and the bar. actionLabel adds one link-style action, like Undo; picking it runs onAction and closes the toast. For messages that must stay on the page, use Alert. See contracts/toast.json for the full contract.

open.note: Shows the toast. Set it when the action happens.

onClose.note: () => void. Runs when the time is up, on the close button, or after the action.

title.note: The bold line, like Saved successfully.

tone.note: Colors the icon and the countdown bar; the toast stays white. info an i, success a check, warning a triangle, danger an error mark.

actionLabel.note: One link-style action under the text, like Undo.

onAction.note: () => void. Runs when the action is picked; the toast then closes.

duration.note: How long it stays, in ms, while the bar counts down. null keeps it until it is closed, with no bar.

useWhen: Confirming an action people just took: saved, sent, deleted.
Offering a quick Undo right after a change.
doNot: Do not use it for errors people must fix or read later. Use Alert on the page.
Do not put more than one action in a toast.
Do not make duration shorter than people need to read it and reach the action.
Do not invent ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastAction or a toast container. Render Toast.
a11y: role status, announced politely; danger toasts are role alert and announced at once.
The countdown pauses while the pointer is over the toast or focus is inside it, so people can read it and reach the action.
The close button is a kit Button named Dismiss. The icon and the bar are decorative.
It fades in unless the person prefers reduced motion.
snippet:
<Toast
  open={saved}
  onClose={() => setSaved(false)}
  title="Saved successfully"
  description="Your changes have been saved."
  actionLabel="Undo"
  onAction={undo}
/>
